SPI General Ledger (GL) Module — OVERVIEW Source: Sidat Hyder Financials Software Guide This section gives an overview of Sidat Hyder Financials, and how it can save your time and effort. **What is Sidat Hyder Financials?** Sidat Hyder Financials is an accounting system that can fully integrate your Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Fixed Assets and General Ledger systems. It is reliable and robust software that will adapt and expand as your business and accounting needs grow. Sidat Hyder Financials gives you the power and flexibility to work the way you want to. Sidat Hyder Financials is full of useful functions that provide solutions to your everyday Accounting problems. Sidat Hyder Financials allows the following: - User defined system configuration and setup - State of the art reporting - Budgeting and cost controls - Multi-currency - Security flexible data entry - Payments & withholding tax - Flexible data entry and - Much more... With an easy to use and intuitive Windows based interface, the system architecture is based on Client Server Technology and has been developed to work in an integrated environment.

more... With an easy to use and intuitive Windows based interface, the system architecture is based on Client Server Technology and has been developed to work in an integrated environment. Whatever combination of programs you use, the functions provided are the same -- you only need to learn how to use the programs once. ### Installing Sidat Hyder Financials Sidat Hyder's implementation staff will carry out the necessary installation procedures. However, your help will be required during the process. The following screens are for the implementation staff. Do I need to sit through the whole process? Yes I would recommend that, as a lot of information that needs to be keyed in will come from you. **How do I install?** Insert the CD named Sidat Hyder Financials General Ledger Module into the CD drive. Double click on the setup icon, the system will ask you for the destination drive on which you would like save the program -- select as desired. ### Frequently Asked Questions (Additional Test Coverage) Q: What is Sidat Hyder Financials? A: An accounting system that fully integrates Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Fixed Assets and General Ledger. Q: What architecture is Sidat Hyder Financials built on? A: Client Server Technology, with an easy-to-use, intuitive Windows-based interface. Q: Do I need to be present during installation? A: Yes — installation is carried out by Sidat Hyder's implementation staff, but client involvement is recommended since much of the information that needs to be keyed in comes from the client. Q: How do I start installing Sidat Hyder Financials? A: Insert the Sidat Hyder Financials General Ledger Module CD, double-click the setup icon, and select the destination drive. Q: What are some capabilities Sidat Hyder Financials provides? A: User-defined system configuration and setup, state-of-the-art reporting, budgeting and cost controls, multi-currency, payments and withholding tax, and flexible data entry.

A: One of the most useful reporting features in the GL system — besides various filter criteria, it has a drill-down feature allowing you to trace transactions right down to the individual voucher entry. Q: Can I restrict the Trial Balance to a specific Chart of Accounts level? A: Yes — you can print for level 1, level 2, or level 3 as defined for your Chart of Accounts structure; upper levels automatically reflect lower-level transactions in group totals. Q: How do I drill down from a Trial Balance report to the actual voucher? A: Double-click any account code on the displayed report to view its Ledger, then

totals. Q: How do I drill down from a Trial Balance report to the actual voucher? A: Double-click any account code on the displayed report to view its Ledger, then click again within the Ledger to reach the voucher level. Q: What does the Ledger report show? A: The ledger for the Chart of Accounts, any secondary Chart of Accounts, or a range of accounts, with the same drill-down feature down to the original voucher. Q: Can the Trial Balance or Ledger report be printed in a different currency than it was entered in? A: Yes, if the multi-currency option is installed — reports can be printed in any desired reporting currency.

Firstly, a list of account heads entered in the system is displayed in the left corner of the screen. It contains the code and the title of account. A search facility is also provided, at the bottom left corner, which could be invoked using code or title as the primary search criteria. Prerequisites Before configuring the Inventory module, confirm the client's chart of accounts has been finalized and the warehouse hierarchy (Site > Warehouse > Bin Location) has been agreed upon during discovery. Inventory setup cannot begin until the client has provided a finalized item master list in the standard SPI import template. 2. Warehouse Hierarchy Configuration Navigate to Inventory > Configuration > Warehouse Setup. Create Sites first, then Warehouses under each Site, then Bin Locations under each Warehouse. Bin Location codes must follow the format AA-00-00 (Aisle- Rack-Shelf) to remain compatible with the barcode scanning module. 3. Item Master Import Use Inventory > Configuration > Item Master Import to bulk-load items from the client's finalized template. Common gap: clients often don't have a consistent unit-of-measure (UOM) standard across items — this is the single most frequent blocker during Inventory go-live and should be flagged during discovery, not during import. 4. A: The client's chart of accounts and warehouse hierarchy (Site > Warehouse > Bin Location), plus a finalized item master list in the standard import template. Q: What default safety stock should be applied if there's no historical consumption data? A: 15% above average monthly usage, until at least one full quarter of real data is available. SPI Implementation Guide — Payroll Module Setup 1. Prerequisites Payroll configuration cannot begin until Finance module chart-of-accounts mapping is complete, since every payroll run posts journal entries back to Finance. Confirm this dependency with the client during scoping — Payroll cannot be configured standalone without Finance already active. 2. Employee Master Setup Navigate to Payroll > Configuration > Employee Master. Employee records require a valid tax jurisdiction code before any salary structure can be assigned. Common gap: clients operating across multiple provinces/states often don't have jurisdiction codes standardized in their HR data — flag this during discovery. 3. Salary Structure Configuration Salary structures (Payroll > Configuration > Salary Structures) define earning and deduction components. At least one structure must be marked as default before any employee can be onboarded into Payroll. 4. Attendance Integration If the client has an existing biometric attendance system, Payroll can integrate via the Attendance Import utility (Payroll > Configuration > Attendance Source). Common Gap Analysis Findings - Multi-currency payroll (for clients with international employees) is not supported out of the box and requires a custom disbursement module — treat as a change request. - Clients frequently assume Payroll includes tax filing/compliance reporting for their specific country; this is jurisdiction-specific and must be scoped separately per client's location. - End-of-service / severance calculations vary significantly by region and are not covered by the default salary structure engine. 6.
